# crosswork_lock_users (Resource)

This resource can lock a local user. The user must exist and be active when the lock is created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_lock_users" "example" {
  username = "cwtest-lockuser"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Username of the user to lock

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_lock_users.example "<username>"
```
